name: Koime Yukari
source:
“Ask me about love!”

Yukari Koime entered Hope's Peak Academy with her love counselling talent. In that sense, it is safe to say that the feeling of love is indispensable to humans.

She also has a book about her love life that she wrote herself, which she always carries in her bag ('Constellation No. 1'). She speaks the Kansai dialect and usually behaves like a dojikko, but she shows her serious side when she is dating. Judging by the way she takes her glasses on and off, she doesn't seem to have bad eyesight. However, like most characters of this kind, the pitfall is that she has never been in a relationship.
